_readme: Posts waiting to go live, oldest first. The daily GitHub Action (scripts/release_posts.py) publishes from the top. Reorder or delete entries here to change what goes out next.

posts.title: Is AI Content Bad for SEO? How to Use It Without Penalties
posts.excerpt: Compliance first playbook for SEO teams: Google's AI content policy, AEO and GEO aware templates, sampling, fact check gates, and audit steps.

posts.title: Knowledge Graph SEO: Help Google Recognize Your Business
posts.excerpt: Actionable steps for SEO teams to implement canonical @id and sameAs, build entity hub pages, and measure Knowledge Panel and AI citations.

posts.title: sameAs Schema: Connect Your Business Profiles for SEO
posts.excerpt: Learn to add sameAs schema with structured data, follow Google and Schema.org guidance, and avoid identity errors when scaling across locations.

posts.title: Internal Linking Strategy: Keep Every Page Within Reach
posts.excerpt: Build an internal linking strategy that connects topic clusters, finds orphaned pages, and supports AI discovery through human review and clear rules.

posts.title: Using ChatGPT to Build Local Citations Without Errors
posts.excerpt: Scale local citations with ChatGPT and protect GBP verification. Agencies can standardize NAP data, adapt directory copy, and verify every listing.

posts.title: Perplexity SEO: How to Get Your Business Cited
posts.excerpt: For engineers: Perplexity SEO tactics. Put evidence first in page leads, refresh facts quarterly, and use NSYGHT entity structure to win AI citations.

posts.title: Gemini SEO: A 90-Day Plan to Protect Your Search Traffic
posts.excerpt: Adapt SEO for Google Gemini in 90 days: prioritize answer first pages, measure with GA4 and Search Console, and protect conversions.

posts.title: Site Speed and Local SEO: Fix What Customers Actually Feel
posts.excerpt: Field first Core Web Vitals guidance for local and service businesses. Prioritize 75th percentile LCP and INP fixes that reduce abandonment.

posts.title: Technical SEO Audit for Local Websites: Scans and Manual Checks
posts.excerpt: Run a technical SEO audit that combines automated scans with manual Search Console and log file checks, then turn findings into developer-ready fixes.

posts.title: Wikidata for SEO: 9 Checks for Better AI Visibility
posts.excerpt: Wikidata supports SEO and AI visibility. Use the nine point checklist, connect entities with sameAs schema, and track impact without assuming rankings.
